entities.summary: Hermann Höcherl was a German politician of the Christian Social Union in Bavaria (CSU). He served as West Germany's Federal Ministry of the Interior from 1961 to 1965 and as Federal Minister for Food, Agriculture and Forests from 1965 to 1969.

entities.summary: Hermann Höcherl was a German politician of the Christian Social Union in Bavaria (CSU). He served as West Germany's Federal Ministry of the Interior from 1961 to 1965 and as Federal Minister for Food, Agriculture and Forests from 1965 to 1969.
